risks.title: Economic slowdown
risks.score_rationale: The company is sensitive to national, regional, and local economic conditions. An economic slowdown could reduce consumer confidence and discretionary spending.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The food distribution industry is highly competitive, with national, multi-regional, regional, and local distributors, as well as online competitors.

risks.title: Inflation and volatile costs
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to volatile costs, including food product costs, which could negatively impact its profit margins.

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on third-party suppliers for its food products, making it vulnerable to supply chain disruptions.

risks.title: Changes in consumer eating habits
risks.score_rationale: Changes in consumer eating habits could negatively impact the company by reducing demand for certain of its products.

risks.title: Dependence on consumer trust
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on consumer trust to maintain its market share and profit margins.

risks.title: Climate change risks
risks.score_rationale: Climate change could negatively impact the company by increasing supply chain-related costs and reducing the availability of certain products.
